name: realTimeProtectionCompliancePercentage
definition: Whole-number percentage (rounded down) of the applicable devices in Defender for Endpoint's secure-configuration assessment for real-time protection (scid-2012) that report it on. It is the share behind isRealTimeProtectionEnabled, so a requirement can set a coverage bar instead of an all-or-nothing boolean.
population: devices the scid-2012 assessment marks applicable (IsApplicable true); not-applicable devices are left out. Windows Defender (classic) keeps applicable devices with an unreadable state in the denominator, never counted as protected.
evidenceRequiredForTrue: Not applicable: a percentage. A value is reported only from scid-2012 rows with at least one applicable device whose state is readable.
citations: Azure/Azure-Sentinel hunting query 'Endpoint Agent Health Status Report': scid-2012 RealtimeProtectionWin

changeLog.change: Registered when the classic Windows Defender check began emitting it; the One-Click check already did (allowlisted, unregistered).

notes: Requirements that need fleet coverage of real-time protection should read this key with greaterThanOrEqual and a bar (98 in Spektrum-owned bundles, spec S3) rather than isRealTimeProtectionEnabled, which is all-or-nothing at One-Click and true-on-one-device at classic. One-Click reports None for the whole response while any applicable device is unreadable and no readable device is non-compliant.
